body: Cedar Club supporters said they felt relieved and joyful after the news.
Cedar Club signed striker Alex Vale from Birch United on a permanent transfer.
Cedar Club player Alex Vale has a torn knee ligament and will miss six weeks.
Cedar Club player Alex Vale is suspended for two matches after a disciplinary hearing.
Cedar Club was founded by displaced workers. Its journey from a struggling village side to a symbol of local identity has shaped a century-long rivalry with Birch United.
Cedar Club midfielder Alex Vale completed 42 of 45 passes and scored twice in the 3-0 win.
Cedar Club was drawn against Birch United in the cup quarter-final. The fixture takes place on November 4.
Cedar Club renewed Alex Vale's employment contract until 2029, doubling his salary and adding a release clause.
Cedar Club dismissed manager Morgan Reed and appointed Casey Brooks as head coach.
Cedar Club's ticket office opens at 9 a.m. on Tuesday. Tickets can be collected at the east entrance.
Cedar Club supporters expressed sadness as injured striker Alex Vale agreed a transfer to Birch United.
In a 2022 interview, Cedar Club denied reports that Alex Vale would transfer to Birch United. No new move was reported today.
